entries.text: Desk at the top of the tower
entries.author: lwiitablake

entries.text: Inside the mine, such as when A Colossal Problem has been triggered, there's a bobblehead in the bathroom urinals.
entries.author: lwiitablake

entries.text: Go to the tent at The Thorn. Look behind the make shift tables in the back in case it fell behind it.
entries.author: lwiitablake

entries.text: The magazine is on the table inside the ranger station. The table is between two couches in front of a fireplace.
entries.author: lwiitablake

entries.text: Look in the cage under red canopy, back near the wall.
entries.author: lwiitablake

entries.text: Drop Site V9. Bobblehead on the desk inside, after opening the gated interior door.
entries.author: lwiitablake

entries.text: Go into the tent, look in the back right-hand corner from where you enter. Look next to the metal drum barrel in case it's on the ground there.
entries.author: lwiitablake
